text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the removal of an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Madelaine Avenue.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Madelaine Avenue, between a point 61 metres north of Denton Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further north.
